It is below the 5-day ($249.0), 10-day ($241.9), 30-day ($303.5), 100-day ($354.0) and 200-day ($350.1). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($221.63), and RSI is 34.7.

No level changed: the $222.89 low undercut the $229.7 support intraday, but the close recovered above it, and the high stalled at the Nov 16 high ($238.85). Resistance is $234.5–238.9, then $241–246 (Nov 13 low, 10-day, Nov 9 close) and $249–254.3 (5-day, Nov 12 low). Support is $229.7–231.9, then $221.6–222.9 (SAR, Nov 9 and 17 lows) and $211.6–212.7. A close above $238.9 would target $241–246; below $229.7, $222.
